The studio

“We shoot the people, the moments, and the merch — and make the graphics to match.”

Hillside Visuals is the media studio of Bisrat Hilete — a Las Vegas photographer, videographer, and designer. From studio portraits and headshots to flyers, reels, and full websites, the work is one thing: made to be looked at.
